rows.selector: AG quality is bad/ not upto the mark
rows.dss: This would seem as poor service from our end (even if it could be connectivity issues). Here we can apologize and provide a a partial refund equivalent to AG price/ our margin to avoid futhure esclaation.

Pre experience:If a guest reaches out before the exp date and time, stating they have not received the AG, we can find this by:1) Checking whether the required AG is sent via email if AG variant is booked along with tickets. For separately sent AG email, please check webengage to check if AG is sent. We can also find AG tickets allotment via PPDashboard for some experiences. If the AG has been alloted and seny, we can resend it to guests.2) If the audio guide is not sent, please send AG and offer a 20% discount code as a token of apology. Post experience:If guest reaches out after the exp is over claiming that we did not send the AG/redemption instructions were unclear/ paid again at the venue, we:-First check whether the AG is sent (variant booked by guest, tix sent, web engage if applicable, pp dashboard if applicable etc)-If not sent, we refund AG amount + discount coupon as an apology.-If sent, we inform guest that we did send AG (attach proof if necessary) and offfer a partial refund equivalent to our margin.Please note: In case the guest says they faced access issues, please issue them a Partial refund for AG amount back to their account on the grounds to avoid further escalation.

rows.selector: Guest is asking for a refund for the Audio Guide part because a free audio guide is available at the venue
rows.dss: 1. Check whether the customer purchased a ticket variant that includes an Audio Guide. Compare the inclusions of the AG and Non-AG variants to confirm whether the price difference is solely for the Audio Guide or if it also covers additional inclusions (like skip the line etc.).2. Once you've confirmed the booking details, verify whether the attraction is actually providing the Audio Guide free of charge. If required, politely ask the customer for supporting information or verify this directly on the attraction's official website.3. If the attraction is offering the Audio Guide for free (+ no other inclusions are listed causing the price increase) and we have charged the customer for an AG variant, refund the price difference between the AG and Non-AG variants per ticket.4. Compare our ticket price with the attraction's ticket price. If the difference is due to the complimentary Audio Guide, offer a refund of up to €5 per ticket.5. Raise the issue with BizOps/BDMs so they are aware that the attraction is providing complimentary Audio Guides and can review the ticket configuration if needed.
